## [1.3.1](https://github.com/JoFSlash/quora-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1) (2026-11-17)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Data saver shows tap targets only for answer and feed images ([e95f4e9](https://github.com/JoFSlash/quora-patches/commit/e95f4e9525b796b027306c10d6a4a96b5eca41da))
* Stop "Clean shared links" from crashing the app on start ([5809add](https://github.com/JoFSlash/quora-patches/commit/5809addd6641bb495015a6eeb3c9f058ddad49da))

patches.name: AMOLED dark mode
patches.description: Uses a pure black background when Quora's dark theme is on.

patches.name: Answer font
patches.description: Sets answers in a serif or a sans-serif font of your phone.

options.description: The kind of font answers are set in.

patches.name: Block Branch tracking
patches.description: Turns on Branch's "disable tracking" mode and turns off its debug mode. Branch tracks where installs come from. Quora's quora.app.link links may open with less detail.

patches.name: Block advertising ID
patches.description: Stops the app from sending your advertising ID and Android ID to Quora.

patches.name: Block app telemetry
patches.description: Stops the app from sending usage logs to Quora, such as reading time, tab presses, experiments, app speed and errors.

patches.name: Block authors and Spaces
patches.description: Hides answers and posts by the people and Spaces you pick.

options.description: Names as Quora shows them, separated by commas. Example: Jane Doe, Cats of Quora

patches.name: Block clipboard reading
patches.description: Stops Quora's pages from reading what you copied. Pasting with the keyboard still works.

patches.name: Block promotional notifications
patches.description: Drops digest and promotional push notifications. Replies, comments and other notifications about you still arrive.

patches.name: Block tracking logs
patches.description: Stops Quora's pages from passing performance and sign-up tracking events to the app.

patches.name: Block web trackers
patches.description: Blocks requests from Quora pages to third-party analytics and tracking services.

patches.name: Clean shared links
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters from Quora links you copy or share.

patches.name: Comfortable reading
patches.description: More space between the lines and paragraphs of answers.

patches.name: Data saver
patches.description: Images load only when you tap them.

patches.name: Disable WebView debugging
patches.description: Stops the app from letting a connected computer inspect its pages, which would show your account's cookies.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance and Facebook app events, and their advertising ID collection.

patches.name: Disable notification prompt
patches.description: Stops the app from asking for permission to show notifications. You can still turn notifications on in Android's settings.

patches.name: Disable rating prompts
patches.description: Stops the app from asking you to rate it on Google Play.

patches.name: Disable sign-in prompts
patches.description: Stops Google's "Save password?" and automatic Google sign-in prompts. You can still sign in with the buttons on the login page.

patches.name: Disable swipe gestures
patches.description: Turns off pulling down to refresh and swiping sideways between feeds, so a page doesn't reload or change while you read.

patches.name: Disable tab prefetching
patches.description: Saves data by loading the other tabs only when you open them.

patches.name: Disable tracking jobs
patches.description: Stops the background jobs that tell Quora every hour whether your phone is charging and every day whether notifications are on.

patches.name: Disable update prompts
patches.description: Stops the app from showing the Google Play update screen.

patches.name: Disable vibration
patches.description: Stops the app from vibrating when you tap buttons such as upvote.

patches.name: Disable video autoplay
patches.description: Videos in the feed and in answers only play when you tap them.

patches.name: Enable text selection
patches.description: Lets you select and copy text on every page.

patches.name: Expand answers
patches.description: Opens shortened answers in full, so you don't have to tap "(more)".

patches.name: Filter keywords
patches.description: Hides answers, posts and questions that mention words you pick.

options.description: Words or phrases, separated by commas. Matching ignores case. Example: crypto, horoscope, Elon Musk

patches.name: Hide AI answers
patches.description: Hides answers written by Poe bots.

patches.name: Hide Ask button
patches.description: Hides the button for asking a question in the top bar and on pages.

patches.name: Hide Poe
patches.description: Hides links and buttons that open Poe or Quora's AI assistant.

patches.name: Hide Quora+ answers
patches.description: Hides answers and posts that can only be read with a Quora+ subscription.

patches.name: Hide Quora+ promotions
patches.description: Hides buttons that ask you to try or join Quora+.

patches.name: Hide Spaces suggestions
patches.description: Hides the Spaces you might like suggestions in the feed.

patches.name: Hide badges
patches.description: Hides the red dots and counts on the bottom bar tabs.

patches.name: Hide counts
patches.description: Hides upvote, view and share counts on answers and posts.

patches.name: Hide downvote button
patches.description: Hides the downvote button on answers and posts.

patches.name: Hide people suggestions
patches.description: Hides "People you may know" and other people to follow in the feed.

patches.name: Hide related questions
patches.description: Hides the related questions lists on question pages.

patches.name: Hide suggested questions
patches.description: Hides the questions for you to answer in the feed.

patches.name: Hide tabs
patches.description: Removes the tabs you pick from the bottom bar. Home always stays.

patches.name: Keep screen on
patches.description: Keeps the screen from turning off while a page is open.

patches.name: Open links in browser
patches.description: Opens links to other websites in your default browser instead of an in-app browser tab.

patches.name: Patch settings
patches.description: Long-press the Home tab to switch the page patches on and off and edit the filters, without patching again.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides promoted answers, sponsored posts and Google ads in the feed and on question pages, and blocks requests to ad servers.

patches.name: Save images
patches.description: Long-press an image you opened full screen to save it to Pictures/Quora.

patches.name: Spoof installer
patches.description: Reports Google Play as the app installer, so Quora does not treat the patched app as installed from an unknown source.

patches.name: Start tab
patches.description: Opens the app on the tab you pick instead of Home.

options.description: The tab the app opens on. If that tab is hidden, the app opens on Home.

patches.name: Text size
patches.description: Makes the text on every page larger or smaller.

options.description: Text size in percent of the default size.

## [1.10.0](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/compare/v1.9.0...v1.10.0) (2026-11-22)

### One patch source for three apps

The Booking.com and Google Health patches moved into this repository, next to the Quora patches, and
the repository is now called **morphe-patches**. This bundle has the patches for all three apps:
75 for Quora, 25 for Booking.com and 12 for Google Health. Morphe Manager shows each app's patches
when you pick that app. [Which apps and what the patches do](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches#readme).

- **Quora:** nothing to do; the old address leads here. What's new for Quora is listed below.
- **Booking.com and Google Health:** the old sources (booking-patches and google-health-patches) get no
  more updates. In Morphe Manager, remove the old source and add this one
  ([link](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=JoFSlash/morphe-patches)), then patch the app again
  and install it over the patched app. You stay signed in, and Booking.com keeps your watched prices.
  The patches themselves are the same as in booking-patches 1.1.0 and google-health-patches 1.1.0.

The bundle is signed with this repository's key ([morphe-signing.pub](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/blob/main/morphe-signing.pub)).

### New features

* Add a For reading preset ([68ca43e](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/68ca43ee2d4f92091ad887eb1abf92a747b73103))
* Backup keeps History, Bookmarks and Dismissed questions too ([2699e6b](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/2699e6b3a5ae067d9a52f6bc959a9f99c252feee))
* Bookmarks, in-app Translate, Hide comment box, Dismissed questions, Slovak settings ([c33a536](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/c33a53666b84797b2b83185bd92874e41dbd650d))
* Check that the app is registered for notifications ([63673c1](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/63673c1e31ba515d03c6f2c193500cfa0a27ec5a))
* Fix hiding patches without a release (Filter updates) ([4f63b4b](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/4f63b4b30c57c92f8da27bcb9beaa8a0ddb9cd19))
* Hide anonymous answers, Read aloud and offline bookmarks ([26fccc0](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/26fccc0c963b5ab29aa16bf9c5809d095499d887))
* Offer presets on the first start after patching ([d03684e](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/d03684e3d266bb29e07639b62856ed198779d30e))
* One patch source for Quora, Booking.com and Google Health ([3f83ad8](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/3f83ad8d119df9d8e128e699ca6b7af5408d7273))
* Patch settings in Czech, French, German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese and Spanish ([8035eb6](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/8035eb655e2564e9c817d471a6b4ed10e940109a))
* Save a backup file with the bookmarks' saved texts ([#51](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/issues/51)) ([a852c37](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/a852c3793abd6a1ced4e385099e691293a3ca73b))
* Save bookmarks with their text to Downloads ([ec8bd16](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/ec8bd1662c015791e17c2a085aeb850ca0dcd8cb))
* Say what to do when Quora stops accepting the app's version ([18353b1](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/18353b15f41364511d0b0e64e31cc1a5f843fd75))
* Show in Patch settings what stops notifications ([6d80a13](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/6d80a13d901e236398636e7f0b78f55a4f44e869))
* Support Quora 3.2.47 ([1ecf9b2](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/1ecf9b2abf2fc5d5db3c7cbfca8c2a88a457b37d))
* Translate long answers in parts ([6cab648](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/6cab6481a108cae7d8f064256d902c0de44634be))
* Turn on Disable video autoplay by default ([cbc179e](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/cbc179e1fc0fe2d77effc0ff57c76de6967a1e72))
* Turn on GmsCore support by default ([693be68](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/693be68566dabf136cfb1975c91bb1a1a46ef118))
* Word count while writing an answer or a post ([7e779d4](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/7e779d434e517d9d04c9a88965ccb00a729a9919))

### Bug fixes

* Block authors no longer hides answers a blocked person only upvoted ([996adf2](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/996adf2541bebf7f024e4e87e541df186133bcf2))
* Bookmark button comes back when Quora redraws the answer's action bar ([523d55a](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/523d55a15455441e46e9fc5bdcde1eaa7ff92ca8))
* Correct the settings translations ([02ce8b6](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/02ce8b68ff0942680c12030daa7ab9e849c55621))

### Documentation

* Add a security policy, a code of conduct and a pull request template ([bb78aa2](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/bb78aa2aea94f2f68c2b537642170eb7cf7653f9))
* Fix the README after the review ([dc4d3c6](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/dc4d3c65e42ff5b1b9bb66fb75ca84109f0a8599))
* Lists in Patch settings, Translate, Report a problem and the tests ([596c673](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/596c673ee5c057e5fe672c574c5eee617d18f205))
* Old Quora versions and Quora in other languages ([1bd6338](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/1bd63381573992c6754ec0a016dd1f225cb39723))
* Say that notifications need GmsCore support ([0bfd9b9](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/0bfd9b900b749c7e7e1e59781c9eaa2afa50fe7e))
* Say which Android versions work, and that Translate sends text to Google ([5229b41](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/5229b4115a40dc448b734825bc8c0900e2fec5b1))
